provenance.classification: Complete source-extracted Update/Clear/FillNavigationPaths and helpers; actual original Game structs, Unity math/RNG, VehicleUtils scalar flags/braking and BuildingUtils geometry execute. ECS lookups/buffers are dictionary/array adapters; three spatial-tree Iterate calls are an explicit supplied FindLane query response, never claimed to execute original native searches. Source lane selector reused from independently checked full iterator. No Unity World executed.
